Interviewer: Ted Panken and audio engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript. 107 pp.

I’m Ted Panken. It’s September 13, 2012. We’re in Eastport, Long Island, with the great Mose Allison, for part one of what we’re anticipating will be a two-session oral history for the Smithsonian in honor of Mose Allison and his Jazz Masters Award. Thank you very much for being here, Mr. Allison, and making us so comfortable.
Let’s start with the facts. Your full name, date of birth, location of birth.
Mose J. Allison, Junior. Date of birth, 11-11-27.
